report.scope: Derived computational enclosure hard vertices are projected to the named source and embedded 0.08mm inside its solid, with local 0.005mm extra inset on residual chord fragments. Soft vertices harmonically continue nearest-source corrections only, without computational inset. Boolean subtraction returns the unchanged true source surface. Original source/collision meshes unchanged.

omittedSamplingHoleRepair.method: Remove isolated closure annulus around omitted height-field sample hole. Close enclosingoperand loops inside unchanged true temporal/disc solids; subtraction recovers modeled gap. No source anatomy modification. Biological soft bridge absent from supplied source data, not asserted absent in vivo.

discAttachmentCorrespondenceRepair.method: Four mixed attachment vertices within0.062mm of the same source disc triangle are aligned inside that exact source facet and share its prescribed rigid motion. Final Boolean boundary uses unchanged source surface.

anteriorPathAttachmentRepair.method: Selected mixed attachment vertices within0.062mm of their local source disc facet are aligned inside that exact facet and share its prescribed rigid motion. Final Boolean boundary uses unchanged source surface.

softFairing.method: Positive inverse-edge-weight Laplacian fairing of derived soft positions and their displacement-field coefficients using identical convex weights. All original source-labelled enclosing anchor vertices remain fixed. Source solids and collision meshes unchanged.
